# orbit test data

- `stations.tle`: CelesTrak `stations` group snapshot, copied unchanged from PR #558
  (`platform/data/redpanda-connect/test/fixtures/stations.tle`, commit `47f8037a`). NORAD 99999
  is that fixture's deliberate bad-checksum record.
- `reference.json`: positions from python-sgp4 2.27 (MIT), generated by `gen_reference.py`.
- `gen_reference.py`: the independent reference (different SGP4 implementation and a separately
  written TEME to geodetic conversion).
